summary: Payments product leader with direct experience owning critical financial infrastructure at Starling Bank and Revolut, including a 34% cut in settlement failures on Faster Payments and an 18% reduction in chargeback disputes through a redesigned claims flow reaching 2.1 million customers. Comfortable leading cross-functional engineering and design teams on complex, reliability-critical payments systems.
